0.name: TEXT_REGWILGLAGUILD_00063_MYLLA_000
0.description: Hm? You've something to ask about the guild, is that it?

5.name: TEXT_REGWILGLAGUILD_00063_MYLLA_010
5.description: Well, I don't just stand around gawping, if that's what you're asking. I am Mylla, guildmaster here.

6.name: TEXT_REGWILGLAGUILD_00063_MYLLA_011
6.description: I instruct these would-be warriors on the finer points of swordsmanship. If you like, I could teach you a thing or two as well, though I can't promise to be gentle.

7.name: TEXT_REGWILGLAGUILD_00063_MYLLA_012
7.description: You'll be bruised and bloody by the time we're finished, but I guarantee you'll be stronger for it. Observe our training and see for yourself.

8.name: TEXT_REGWILGLAGUILD_00063_MYLLA_020
8.description: Gladiators aspire to become masters of the sword, the most ubiquitous weapon in all of Eorzea.

9.name: TEXT_REGWILGLAGUILD_00063_MYLLA_021
9.description: The sword is a deceptively simple weapon, which is why many take it up to achieve their goals. Wealth, power, love─all seem within reach when duly armed.

10.name: TEXT_REGWILGLAGUILD_00063_MYLLA_022
10.description: A gladiator, however, understands that to live by the sword is not a decision to be taken lightly. To walk upon the bloodsands is to court death, and we must ever be prepared to enter Thal's realm.

11.name: TEXT_REGWILGLAGUILD_00063_MYLLA_023
11.description: But when you stand triumphant in the Coliseum and hear the crowd chanting your name, you feel...immortal.

12.name: TEXT_REGWILGLAGUILD_00063_MYLLA_024
12.description: Of course, victory goes only to those willing to work for it. A gladiator must rigorously train not only to deliver fierce attacks, but also to weather them. Indeed, learning the shield is just as important as learning the sword.

13.name: TEXT_REGWILGLAGUILD_00063_MYLLA_025
13.description: These defensive skills are especially important when fighting alongside allies. In battle, a gladiator is often relied upon to draw the enemy's attention while his weaker allies seize the opportunity to attack.

14.name: TEXT_REGWILGLAGUILD_00063_MYLLA_026
14.description: It is for this reason that gladiators are often considered indispensable in battle, for none are more skilled in the arts of war than we.

15.name: TEXT_REGWILGLAGUILD_00063_MYLLA_000_050
15.description: Well, if it isn't <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! What wind blows you here?

16.name: TEXT_REGWILGLAGUILD_00063_MYLLA_000_060
16.description: It's not every day a famous free paladin darkens our door. To what do we owe the pleasure, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>?

17.name: TEXT_REGWILGLAGUILD_00063_MYLLA_000_070
17.description: You are yet welcome here, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Marshal Tarupin made it clear that you were innocent of all charges─not that we needed to be told the truth! No student of mine would dare sully <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> blade with royal blood.

18.name: TEXT_REGWILGLAGUILD_00063_MYLLA_000_071
18.description: No further need to skulk about, eh? Not that there was much before, but you can hardly accuse someone of murder when the victim is alive and well.

19.name: TEXT_REGWILGLAGUILD_00063_MYLLA_400_000
19.description: This tournament brings together the realm's finest. If you are to rise above them, nothing less than complete preparation will suffice.

20.name: TEXT_REGWILGLAGUILD_00063_MYLLA_400_001
20.description: Before your turn comes to step into the arena, I suggest you put what time you have to good use, be it honing your skills or upgrading your gear.

21.name: TEXT_REGWILGLAGUILD_00063_MYLLA_400_010
21.description: I never doubted that you could win through to the final, but to witness it all unfold was nothing short of awe-inspiring!

22.name: TEXT_REGWILGLAGUILD_00063_MYLLA_400_011
22.description: The winner of the Nald group will square off against you for the title, and suffice it to say I intend to be that person.

23.name: TEXT_REGWILGLAGUILD_00063_MYLLA_400_012
23.description: I shall see to it that a match between us becomes a reality, and I hope that I can count on your support!

24.name: TEXT_REGWILGLAGUILD_00063_MYLLA_400_020
24.description: I'm sorry that I could not meet you in the final, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, but I've no doubt that you will do our guild proud.

25.name: TEXT_REGWILGLAGUILD_00063_MYLLA_400_021
25.description: I look forward to seeing you clash with Black Lotus and, needless to say, come away with the win.

26.name: TEXT_REGWILGLAGUILD_00063_MYLLA_400_030
26.description: I shall see to convincing the organizers to host the final. Until such time as the match is confirmed, take what rest you can. You will need it.

27.name: TEXT_REGWILGLAGUILD_00063_MYLLA_400_040
27.description: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, always a pleasure. Your Ul Cup victory lit a fire in our members' bellies, and they train like men and women possessed.

29.name: TEXT_REGWILGLAGUILD_00063_MYLLA_500_000
29.description: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, always a pleasure. Whenever you visit, our members train that little bit harder. Funny, that.

35.name: TEXT_REGWILGLAGUILD_00063_MYLLA_000_100
35.description: Your concern for my well-being is touching, albeit unwarranted.

36.name: TEXT_REGWILGLAGUILD_00063_MYLLA_000_101
36.description: I am fine, the guild is fine, Aldis is─ Oh, who gives a damn how Aldis is?

37.name: TEXT_REGWILGLAGUILD_00063_MYLLA_000_102
37.description: More importantly, any time you waste worrying about the affairs of others would be better spent further honing your skills.

38.name: TEXT_REGWILGLAGUILD_00063_MYLLA_000_110
38.description: The life of a gladiator is never easy, but I cannot complain. Certain members of the guild have achieved greater recognition in recent days, which has led to a surge of applicants.

39.name: TEXT_REGWILGLAGUILD_00063_MYLLA_000_111
39.description: They are eager to learn, I will grant them that. Yet they struggle to grasp the basics still. For example, the other day I was explaining the concept of eliciting an opponent's enmity. Surely you recall the lesson? It involved shouting at marauders.

40.name: TEXT_REGWILGLAGUILD_00063_MYLLA_000_112
40.description: One recruit took forever and a day to understand that his words were not enough, and that he needed to motion to himself to achieve the full effect. Even now, I cannot fathom why he struggled so...

41.name: TEXT_REGWILGLAGUILD_00063_MYLLA_400_100
41.description: The life of a gladiator is never easy, but I cannot complain. A certain member of the guild has distinguished <hex:020815E905FF0868657273656C66FF0868696D73656C6603> in recent days, which has led to a surge of applicants.

42.name: TEXT_REGWILGLAGUILD_00063_MYLLA_400_101
42.description: These new ones train long and hard in the hopes of emulating your greatness, and while their enthusiasm is commendable, it's early days still.

43.name: TEXT_REGWILGLAGUILD_00063_MYLLA_400_102
43.description: Only time will tell who will go the distance, but you may be certain that I will push them for all they're worth.

44.name: TEXT_REGWILGLAGUILD_00063_MYLLA_400_103
44.description: I couldn't do any less, what with the bar having been raised so high. Right, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>?

45.name: TEXT_REGWILGLAGUILD_00063_MYLLA_500_100
45.description: Since Aldis decided to stay, we've had more folk come knocking on our door.

46.name: TEXT_REGWILGLAGUILD_00063_MYLLA_500_101
46.description: They aspire to be like the Sword of Nald. And like your good self, of course.

47.name: TEXT_REGWILGLAGUILD_00063_MYLLA_500_102
47.description: Only time will tell who will go the distance, but you may be certain that I will push them for all they're worth.

48.name: TEXT_REGWILGLAGUILD_00063_MYLLA_500_103
48.description: I couldn't do any less, what with the bar having been raised so high. Right, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>?

49.name: TEXT_REGWILGLAGUILD_00063_MYLLA_600_100
49.description: For a time, our halls were somewhat empty, what with a good portion of our members enlisted to aid the efforts in Garlemald at Her Grace's request.

50.name: TEXT_REGWILGLAGUILD_00063_MYLLA_600_101
50.description: Those who remained were largely engaged with keeping the tempered appearing from the towers at bay. For a blessing, we were able to keep casualties to a minimum─proof, if any were needed, of the efficacy of our techniques.

51.name: TEXT_REGWILGLAGUILD_00063_MYLLA_600_102
51.description: As for myself, I understand all too well the importance of constant improvement. With so many talented students, it would be most unbecoming if any were to surpass their guildmaster, and so I maintain a strict training regimen of my own.

52.name: TEXT_REGWILGLAGUILD_00063_MYLLA_600_103
52.description: I couldn't do any less, what with the bar having been raised so high. Right, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>?

59.name: TEXT_REGWILGLAGUILD_00063_MYLLA_000_120
59.description: Who are you, and what did you do with <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? Because I know <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> wouldn't be so daft as to─ Oh, the hells with it.

67.name: TEXT_REGWILGLAGUILD_00063_MYLLA_000_128
67.description: That, my friend, is the crux of it. But as you have experienced firsthand, there is more to the sword and shield than meets the eye. Our art is ever evolving, and it falls to us to evolve with it.<hex:02100103>...Just to be clear─You <hex:021A020203>are<hex:021A020103> <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, and not <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> twin <hex:020814E905FF07736973746572FF0862726F7468657203>, right?
